overview_description.description: Style Lend (formerly Stylend) is a fashion rental marketplace. Style Lend helps women look amazing at any event by allowing her to borrow the perfect dress at a tenth of the retail price from another stylish woman. At the same time StyleLend allows women to monetize their dresses by lending them out to other women, without having to sell them.
